brief.problem: A claims transformation launched six months ago, usage is high, but promised cycle-time and loss-adjustment benefits were never baselined or assigned to owners.
brief.decision: Determine what value was realized and which corrective actions should continue into the next release.
brief.context: Implementation records, operating metrics, benefit estimates, and user feedback are available.
constraints: Do not rewrite the original business case after seeing results
brief.desired_output: Baseline reconstruction, benefit measures, attribution limits, owner actions, and follow-up gates.

brief.problem: Two dominant competitors may respond aggressively if a supplier cuts price, but their capacity constraints and likely retaliation differ by region.
brief.decision: Choose a regional pricing move and reversible response rules under uncertain competitor behavior.
brief.context: Market shares, capacity, historical reactions, economics, and customer switching data are available.
constraints: Do not assume competitors remain passive
brief.desired_output: Competitor response tree, scenarios, payoffs, trigger points, and staged recommendation.

brief.problem: Eight executives disagree about which service lines to stop, but the discussion cycles through anecdotes and the loudest voice dominates.
brief.decision: Run a working session that creates options, evaluates them against shared criteria, and ends with explicit decisions.
brief.context: Pre-read economics and customer evidence exist; the need is a fair, structured decision process.
constraints: Do not reopen data collection during the session
brief.desired_output: Workshop sequence, stakeholder roles, option-generation method, decision criteria, and recorded commitments.

brief.problem: A conglomerate's small logistics subsidiary consumes management attention, has weak strategic fit, and may be worth more to an industry buyer.
brief.decision: Choose whether to retain, partner, carve out, or sell the subsidiary and how to prepare the decision.
brief.context: Standalone economics are incomplete, shared services are intertwined, and two potential buyers have shown interest.
constraints: Do not launch a sale before identifying value leakage
brief.desired_output: Ownership alternatives, parenting-fit logic, standalone value, separation requirements, and decision gates.

brief.problem: A product group has fifty innovation concepts, scarce engineering capacity, and a history of carrying weak ideas because no one owns kill decisions.
brief.decision: Create an evidence-based funnel and fund the next three experiments.
brief.context: Customer problem statements, rough economics, technical risk, and strategic themes are available at uneven quality.
constraints: Make kill criteria explicit before experiments begin
brief.desired_output: Comparable concept screen, staged evidence gates, experiment portfolio, owners, and continue-pivot-stop rules.

brief.problem: A multinational holds excess cash in one region while another draws expensive short-term debt, and currency exposures are managed differently by each unit.
brief.decision: Define centralized liquidity, funding, and foreign-exchange governance.
brief.context: Entity cash, debt, forecasts, banking arrangements, restrictions, and exposures are available.
brief.desired_output: Cash visibility, pooling options, funding rules, risk limits, roles, controls, and implementation sequence.

brief.problem: Before close, buyer and seller teams need integration planning data, but sharing customer-level prices and employee decisions could violate competition and confidentiality limits.
brief.decision: Define what can be analyzed, by whom, and how findings can inform Day 1 planning without contaminating operating teams.
brief.context: A signed deal awaits regulatory clearance; external counsel and a neutral analysis team are available.
brief.desired_output: Clean-team scope, data rules, access roles, aggregation thresholds, escalation path, and approved outputs.

brief.problem: Organic search traffic is stable but qualified pipeline from search has fallen as high-intent pages lost rankings and content production follows volume rather than buyer need.
brief.decision: Choose the next-quarter search strategy and content priorities tied to pipeline quality.
brief.context: Search Console, analytics, CRM attribution, competitor rankings, content inventory, and conversion paths are available.
constraints: Separate technical, intent, content, and conversion causes
brief.desired_output: Search diagnosis, keyword-intent portfolio, technical priorities, content plan, conversion tests, and measures.

brief.problem: Warranty returns reveal that an engineered pump meets the written specification but fails installation and maintenance needs that customers never translated into technical requirements.
brief.decision: Redesign the next version's requirements and verification plan around customer needs and failure risk.
brief.context: Customer interviews, service records, warranty failure modes, engineering measures, and prototype capacity are available.
constraints: Trace every priority need to an engineering characteristic and test
brief.desired_output: Customer-needs hierarchy, requirement matrix, technical priorities, failure prevention, prototype, and verification plan.

brief.problem: A company added account-management responsibilities to technical roles, but job levels, pay bands, performance expectations, and development criteria still reflect the old work.
brief.decision: Redefine the roles and performance system before the next compensation cycle.
brief.context: Role descriptions, employee interviews, market-pay data, performance ratings, and customer outcomes are available.
constraints: Do not change pay before roles and criteria are calibrated
brief.desired_output: Role analysis, level criteria, competency expectations, evaluation logic, performance measures, and transition plan.

brief.problem: A three-year infrastructure program is closing with unresolved vendor claims, incomplete benefit ownership, undocumented operational handoffs, and repeated lessons likely to be lost.
brief.decision: Close the program cleanly and preserve actionable learning for the next capital program.
brief.context: Contracts, acceptance records, risks, benefits, issue logs, and stakeholder interviews are available.
constraints: Do not call administrative closure a successful outcome
brief.desired_output: Closure criteria, residual-action register, benefit handoff, lessons with evidence, owners, and archive.

brief.problem: A grocery chain wants to improve cross-sell, but simple co-purchase counts overstate items that are individually popular and vary by store format.
brief.decision: Identify actionable product associations and store segments for merchandising tests.
brief.context: Transaction baskets, product hierarchy, promotions, prices, loyalty IDs, and store attributes are available.
constraints: Control for base rates and promotions
brief.desired_output: Association rules, customer or store segments, lift thresholds, test cells, and evaluation plan.

brief.problem: A single overseas supplier makes a safety-critical component; alternate qualification takes nine months and port, geopolitical, and quality risks are rising.
brief.decision: Choose the resilience investments and trigger-based sourcing plan for the next year.
brief.context: Supplier financials, lead times, inventory, qualification costs, disruption scenarios, and customer service effects are available.
constraints: Quantify both risk exposure and resilience cost
brief.desired_output: Risk map, exposure scenarios, inventory and source options, triggers, owners, and continuity tests.

brief.problem: An ecommerce company must replace a failing fulfillment partner while deciding whether to use one integrated lead-logistics provider or several specialized operators.
brief.decision: Choose the logistics operating model and provider selection process before peak season.
brief.context: Order profiles, lanes, service failures, facility needs, cost components, provider capabilities, and peak forecasts are available.
constraints: Compare operating-model risk as well as bid price
brief.desired_output: 3PL versus 4PL decision, network requirements, total-cost model, provider scorecard, transition risks, and award gates.

brief.problem: Business units have created hundreds of low-code apps and bots with duplicate logic, embedded credentials, weak support ownership, and no retirement process.
brief.decision: Set a governed citizen-development and automation model without stopping useful local innovation.
brief.context: Microsoft Power Platform, several RPA tools, a central security team, and distributed process owners.
constraints: Make compliant development easier than shadow work
brief.desired_output: Platform boundaries, intake and lifecycle, control tiers, ownership, reusable components, monitoring, and rollout.
